title: On Adoration and Worship in Spirit and Truth, Book 2
blurb: Cyril continues the dialogue with Palladius on worship in spirit and truth. Book 2 of a seventeen-book dialogue — not the whole work.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Cyril’s long On Adorations (seventeen books) — no previous English translation. This is Book 2 only. The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Migne PG 68 (Aubert reprint). The PDF and a cleaned text of the same print were checked against each other. This page is Book 2 of seventeen. This is a reading translation for study, not a new critical edition of the Greek.

witnesses.name: Migne PG 68 De adoratione Book 2 (Aubert reprint)
